mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, order_id, receive_time, use_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{receiveTime}, #{useTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY receive_time DESC
SELECT * FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY expire_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}
